note: must_show items reworded under SPEC.md item 6c (revision 2 after first use, development). rev1: the wording the rule set had before (rules/<regime>/rev1/); now: the wording in rules.json and the workflows (null: item removed). Designs and blind-check records written before revision 2 name items by their rev1 wording; the generator maps them through this file.

items.rev1: that and when CSS was notified of the theft
items.now: the date (day, month and year) on which the theft was notified to CSS

items.rev1: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2), or its absence
items.now: the supplementary insurance for simple theft away (Ziff. 24.2), listed among the policy's covers as included or as not included

items.rev1: where and when it was bought
items.now: for each item, where and when it was bought, or, for an item that was not bought, that it was a gift or inherited and when

items.rev1: the original voucher for each stolen or damaged item whose voucher can be obtained without considerable cost
items.now: an original purchase voucher for each stolen or damaged item, except an item for which the file states that its voucher cannot be obtained without considerable cost

items.rev1: the bicycle, if its voucher can be obtained without considerable cost
items.now: the bicycle it is for (make, model or type)
